results.title: CENTCOM Commander Visits Six Countries During Middle East Tour
results.description: The U.S. military has announced that General Brad Cooper, commander of U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM), visited six countries during a 10-day trip to the Middle East. CENTCOM said early Sunday, August 16, in a post on X that Cooper also visited a U.S. Navy aircraft carrier in the Arabian Sea. DAP votes to remain in Anwar-led unity government
results.description: DAP delegates at the 2026 National Congress voted 1,857 to 242 in favor of remaining in Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's unity government despite political pressure.

results.title: Democrats Disagree over Abolishing or Reforming ICE at DNC Meeting
results.description: Democrats on Saturday approved dueling messages on whether US Immigration and Customs Enforcement should be abolished or reformed, reflecting sharp opposition to President Donald Trump's crackdown but revealing disagreement in the party ahead of the midterms. The Democratic National Committee, gathered for a summer meeting, also signed off on a raft of policy positions, including one that calls for “concrete reforms” of ICE and another for abolishing the agency that's been at the center of several fatal encounters.
